decision: A bounded fixed-bank diagnostic has a new concrete source/cache basis; no physics-equivalence, forecast-invariance, ranking-harm or defense experiment has been executed for this candidate.
research_question: Can different finite action representations with exactly the same executed XYZ controls change deterministic DINO-WM forecasts and native-objective ranking enough to select a physically worse action sequence?
scope: Read-only source inspection and one JSON-only count of existing actually executed Clean actions. No model loading, inference, environment execution, API request, training, checkpoint download or weight hashing.
execution_priority: Do not start this second model/environment experiment in the present round. The separately selected action-geometry coupling gate has priority.

existing_carrier.clean_result: Two of three fixed development episodes have final native success. This is a small normal-capability panel, not general strong-controller evidence.
existing_carrier.strong_control_limit: The matched servo has final success 0/3 but ever-success 3/3 and higher cumulative reward on all three roots. Preserve both final-success and reward/ever-success conclusions; a later prefix diagnostic does not inherit a forecast-selection advantage.
existing_carrier.native_selection: CEM uses 300 candidates, 15 iterations, 10 elites, H6 and returns three macro actions. Each 20D macro is five consecutive 4D physical controls. The fixed native objective is final visual-feature MSE plus 0.1 times proprio-feature MSE.

source_chain.fact: Normalization is (a - mean) / std; denormalization is z * std + mean. Neither operation clips actions.
The published MetaWorld four-coordinate action mean/std are used by the existing loader, repeated by reshaping each five-control macro rather than treating normalized [-1,1] as executor bounds.

CEM samples normalized proposals. Its optional max_norms defaults to None and is absent in the inspected native reach configuration. Proposals enter cost_function before elite selection; the returned action is the first three rows of the final elite mean.
cost_function calls unroll(z_init, actions), then the native objective on its forecast.

EncPredWM.unroll receives normalized act_suffix[T,B,20], rearranges it, encodes actions and calls forward_pred autoregressively. It does not denormalize and apply the MetaWorld XYZ clip before action encoding.

Action encoding consumes the supplied values; the dino_wm forecast concatenates observation/action/proprio features and applies its predictor. This is an evaluation-mode feedforward forecast path, not a diffusion conditional sampler. No new repeatability test was performed.
Returned normalized macros are reshaped into 4D controls and affine-denormalized before env.step. Logged action values are these raw requested controls, not executor-clipped values.
The tensor wrapper passes action.numpy() onward.
The MetaWorld wrapper passes action.copy() into the underlying environment.

set_xyz_action first applies np.clip(action,-1,1), scales the result, updates bounded mocap position and fixes mocap orientation. step passes action[:3] to this function and the unchanged gripper scalar to do_simulation([a_g,-a_g]).

Reach success and reward are derived from TCP/finger position relative to the fixed target. The inspected reach reward does not penalize the raw XYZ command. This claim is not generalized to tasks with raw-action costs.

exact_alias_contract.domain: Finite 4D requested controls a=(ax,ay,az,ag), evaluated at the actual execution dtype after the native affine denormalizer.
exact_alias_contract.definition: a ~ b iff np.clip(a[:3],-1,1) equals np.clip(b[:3],-1,1) coordinatewise and b[3] equals a[3] exactly. Apply this condition to every corresponding physical sub-control in a sequence.
exact_alias_contract.allowed_edit: Only XYZ representations already on the same saturation side may differ; keep all unsaturated XYZ coordinates and the gripper unchanged. Do not change action order, sequence length, timing, target, observation, weights, scoring or other candidates.
sufficient_source_conditions: Start from the same complete simulator and wrapper state, including mocap, integration/warm-start fields, task parameters, RNG where applicable, counters and observation history.
Use the same action scaling, frameskip, control count, simulator implementation and timestep.
Preserve the raw gripper control exactly; do not rely on a second actuator-clipping equivalence claim.
For this reach task, equal physical transitions imply equal state-based reward and success. Other tasks with raw-command penalties require a separate utility-equivalence check.
exact_alias_contract.deployment_precision_caveat: An algebraic normalize/denormalize round trip may round a canonical boundary to just inside +/-1. Verify the actual float32-denormalized and np.clip results, and preserve untouched normalized coordinates bit-for-bit, before accepting any alias. No such numerical/physics acceptance test was executed in this report.
exact_alias_contract.source_inference_not_measurement: Under these conditions the inspected executor should issue the same mocap and gripper controls. Exact whole-trajectory, rendered-observation and utility equivalence remain to be measured, not asserted from the count.

existing_action_log_count.scope: Actually executed policy controls only; excludes the one warmup control and all unexecuted CEM candidates. Counts are over raw logged action[:3], before executor clipping.
existing_action_log_count.interpretation: Executor saturation occurs frequently in existing native Clean trajectories, before any proposed intervention. This does not establish training-distribution membership, forecast error, alias invariance failure, attack reachability or task harm.

relation_to_archived_work.wav_correction: At inspection the registry labelled the direction untested, although the original config records a one-step diagnostic on 128 states and 151 oracle alias groups (93.38%-96.69% split rates across four checkpoints). Root subsequently corrected that registry label to observed_dependence_only. No attacker/controller task harm is established; neither the old diagnostic nor a new DINO result was rerun.
relation_to_archived_work.cosmos_difference: Earlier Cosmos alias conditions were fed to a joint conditional generative sampler; identical actuator decoding alone does not require identical joint conditional samples. Its valid action-alias windows showed no ranking flips or harm. The present DINO path uses deterministic action-conditioned forecasts, and the exact executor saturation map is exercised by native Clean actions. This is a better-defined causal action-equivalence diagnostic, not evidence that the old Cosmos negative result was wrong.
relation_to_archived_work.new_fact: Available checkpoint plus native forecast-based CEM, a measured small Clean gate, explicit normalized-proposal/raw-executor clipping mismatch, and 147/297 naturally saturated requested controls.
relation_to_archived_work.novelty_limit: Action equivalence, model exploitation, clipping mismatches and quotient-MDP abstractions are not new principles. No new literature search or novelty claim is made. A useful systems-security contribution still needs a stated representation-writer permission, measured decision harm and selective recovery.

minimal_interface_and_diagnostic_boundar.interface: The concrete research hook is the act_suffix argument at native cost_function -> EncPredWM.unroll. It can change only an equivalent XYZ representation in a copied forecast request while retaining candidate identity, raw executable control sequence, original goal and native scoring. No deployed low-trust remote writer has been identified.
minimal_interface_and_diagnostic_boundar.candidate_bank: A separately preregistered fixed bank can reuse existing actual action sequences and initial-state/goal caches, with real prefix outcomes obtained from matching saved trajectories or exact environment replays. Freeze its roots, candidates, horizon, alias rule and utility before any new predictions; do not select aliases or candidates by observed forecast error or utility.
minimal_interface_and_diagnostic_boundar.existing_cache_limit: queries.json stores the returned three-macro prefix and per-iteration minimum costs, not all 300 CEM candidates, full unexecuted H6 tails or forecast arrays. Concatenating later closed-loop actions produces a new fixed open-loop sequence, not the original H6 candidate. It must be labelled accordingly.
minimal_interface_and_diagnostic_boundar.decision_scope: Using native model/unroll/objective on a fixed bank is an added diagnostic selector, not a replay of complete native adaptive CEM. Short-prefix distance/reward is real measured utility but is not whole-episode success or a native closed-loop attack success rate.
minimal_interface_and_diagnostic_boundar.cem_geometry_limit: Clipping is nonlinear: averaging different alias representations can change the executable mean. Editing the candidate tensors used by CEM elite averaging would therefore add an optimizer-geometry path. A forecast-request-only diagnostic must retain the original candidate tensors and identity mapping to isolate forecast sensitivity.
necessary_gate_before_claim: At actual precision, verify every proposed alias gives the same effective XYZ controls and unchanged gripper; replay source and alias from identical restored state to check physical trajectories, images, reward and success.
Measure fixed-action forecast error against independently observed physical consequences; visual/proprio divergence alone is not an error or attack success.

Measure ranking and selected-candidate utility using the same original native objective and real candidate outcomes. Show a competent Clean selector on that fixed bank rather than inheriting the full-policy 2/3 result.

Any canonicalization repair must use the executor-equivalent representation at deployment precision, retain equal model calls and scoring, and report its Clean cost. Recovery of feature equality alone is insufficient.
